categories: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

concerns.quote: In clinical practice the fetal CTG continues to be a source of problems, both in interpretation and in what degree of action should be taken
concerns.hazard: inconsistent interpretation of antenatal CTG leading to delayed or inappropriate response

concerns.quote: Reliance on the NICE guidance for intrapartum CTG monitoring to interpret antenatal CTG features is of limited value because: (i) It is not intended for such use and therefore such practice is arguably not evidence based (ii) It is much more common for fetal heart traces not to look normal during labour (in the region 20 -30 % outwith normal parameters) therefore the significance of such abnormal traces may not be the same in labour as compared to when identified antenatally. concerns.hazard: misapplication of intrapartum CTG guidance to antenatal monitoring

concerns.quote: There should be a review to consider whether national guidance on antepartum CTG monitoring and interpretation where there are abnormalities or unusual features would lead to safer, evidence based management of such cases
concerns.hazard: lack of national guidance for antepartum CTG abnormalities

reports.title: Alonzo Wood: Prevention of Future Deaths Report
categories: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

concerns.quote: clinicians consider that there is insufficient guidance as to the management actions that should be taken in the event of an abnormal antenatal CTG
concerns.hazard: insufficient guidance on management of abnormal antenatal CTG

links.explanation: Both reports highlight the absence of clear national guidance on how to respond to abnormal antenatal cardiotocography findings. This leads to reliance on individual clinician judgement regarding the need and timing of delivery.
links.earlier_quote: Currently there is no detailed national guidance on antepartum CTG assessment and therefore no guidance as to the circumstances in which CTG changes or abnormalities require urgent delivery.
links.later_quote: clinicians consider that there is insufficient guidance as to the management actions that should be taken in the event of an abnormal antenatal CTG
